snippet.description:
Lanterns Episode 3 Trailer. John Stewart Gets His Comic Book Green Lantern Suit, Nathan Fillion Guy Gardner, Sinestro and Hal Jordan, Is Hal Jordan really dead, Who is the manhunter & Lanterns Episode 4 ► https://bit.ly/AwesomeSubscribe

House Of The Dragon Season 3 Episode 8 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vTtyyFhtNDg&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxGuSDE8NtOuthqbKFChC0q&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WOfZwL4NKFE&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwWT3yd94Xc6n-ooI85uV_u&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
Emergency Awesome New Videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeOfhzu7ZdY&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxQXxyV_2D8kuEs_QsuQIyJ&index=7

Covering New Green Lantern Lanterns Episode 3 Trailer Breakdown and Easter Eggs. Sinestro Explains The Yellow Power Of Fear to Hal Jordan and the Yellow Lantern Corps, the prophecy of Blackest Night and the War of Light. John Stewart comic book accurate green lantern suit. What happened to Sinestro, why Lanterns is setting up the Manhunters and the secret history of the Guardians of OA and the other emotional spectrum like yellow lanterns, red lanterns and more.

Who the Manhunter really is, why the Rushville Town is fake. New Episodes, Hal Jordan, John Stewart, Guy Gardner Nathan Fillion. Hal Jordan vs Sinestro First Look. Green Lantern HBO Episodes explained. Lanterns Season 1, story and plot, how it connects to the Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow Movie and other upcoming DC Movies. Manhunters Explained. Wider ramifications for future DCU Movies. Lanterns Episode 3 - 8 Trailer Footage.

James Gunn DC Movies New Justice League Announcement, Canceled DC Movies and TV Shows recently. Zack Snyder and James Gunn meeting. Superman 2, Green Lantern HBO First Look, Teen Titans Movie announcement. The new Batman and other new DC movies & tv shows.

Lanterns is supposed to run for multiple seasons, and help to build out the cosmic side of the DCU like the Supergirl Movie and other future space based dc movies and tv shows. There will be other major DC characters cameo scenes on the show, Nathan Fillion Guy Gardner, other green lanterns, Oa and the Oans. In addition to Sinestro and  other comic book characters.

David Corenswet Superman, Rachel Brosnahan Lois Lane Explained. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Nathan Fillion Green Lantern, Hawkgirl, Mr Terrific and more new Justice League characters. Why The New Justice League is based more on the Animated Justice League Team.

Henry Cavill Superman Future Plans, Deleted Scenes. Lots more DC and Marvel Trailers coming, Avengers Doomsday Trailer, X-Men 2028 Teasers and More Spider-Man videos soon too!

My Full Lanterns Episode 3 video will post sun!

snippet.description:
#AvengersDoomsday #Avengers #Marvel 

AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
The end of an era begins.

MovieTrailers Entertainment presents the "Sacrifice" Final Trailer Concept for Marvel Studios' AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY, the next major event in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

A new threat is rising. The Avengers are assembling once again. And at the center of it all stands Doctor Doom.

Crystal Lake Series Trailer Breakdown:

0:00 Camp Crystal Lake Opens Again 
0:19 Jason Voorhees Drowns
0:30 Friday the 13th Birthday
0:40 Town is Cursed

1:12 Mommy's Here

──────────────────

"The legend begins... with Pam."

A new Crystal Lake trailer has dropped to remind you that the original Friday the 13th killer wasn't Jason Voorhees. It was his mother, Pamela Voorhees. 

A24's highly anticipated Crystal Lake TV show is making a major stop at New York Comic Con before its official debut on Peacock and HBO Max. The studio has confirmed that the Crystal Lake premiere episode will receive an exclusive first-look screening at the Empire Stage at the Javits Center in New York City.

Following the screening, attendees will be treated to a panel discussion featuring series creator Brad Caleb Kane (IT Welcome to Derry) and several members of the cast, including Linda Cardellini (Pamela), William Catlett, Devin Kessler, Cameron Scoggins (Officer Dorf), Gwendolyn Sundstrom (Claudette), and Callum Vinson (Jason). 

This early screening offers a unique opportunity for fans to see how the production expands the mythology of the Friday the 13th franchise. By showcasing the episode at a major event like New York Comic Con, the creative team is signaling confidence in the Crystal Lake series as it prepares for its wider streaming release.

Serving as a Friday the 13th prequel series to the 1980 horror movie classic, Crystal Lake trailer focuses on the life of Pamela Voorhees before she became the iconic killer. Linda Cardellini stars as Pamela, portraying a single mother struggling with grief nearly a year after the tragic drowning of her young son, Jason Voorhees. The narrative kicks off when two strangers arrive at her home to investigate her past, triggering a disturbing chain of events.

While the premise leans into psychological drama and conspiracy thriller elements, creator Kane has assured fans that the horror series will eventually embrace the bloody horror associated with the iconic horror movie franchise. He has teased that the series will feature numerous connections to the original films, including various Viernes 13 Easter eggs and recreations of familiar elements that long-time Friday the 13th fans will recognize.

The Camp Crystal Lake horror series has seen significant changes since it was first ordered by Peacock in 2022. While Bryan Fuller was initially attached as the writer and show runner, he departed the A24 project in 2024, leading to Kane taking over creative duties. Despite these behind-the-scenes shifts, the crystal lake show has already secured distribution with HBO Max for Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the UK, and Ireland.

All eight episodes of Crystal Lake premiere on Peacock October 15, 2026 and internationally on HBO Max by year's end.

snippet.title: Czarface Meets Frankie Pulitzer - "Mad Technology" feat. Method Man (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Czarface Meets Frankie Pulitzer - The New Album - Out now!

Now streaming everywhere! 
https://czarface.lnk.to/czarfacemeetsfrankiepulitzer

Shop vinyl, CD, cassette's and the merch collection now at - https://www.shop.czarface.com

Executive Producer: @Steveswestpants 
Co-directors: Andy To @andyto / Stevesweatpants 
Steadicam: Storr Todd @storrybook 
2nd cam: Chris Gleaton @gleatoncreative
Editor: Dylan Bautista @dyl.batista 

Lyrics: 

Method Man

Mr. Mef, Frankie P not Sinatra but frankly we 
are Frankenstein's monster momma 
raised me on franks and beans
mean microphone fiend no one nicer than king
you're too lean and light in the jeans to even fight for a dream 
rap scene way too green got too much ice in their cream
i done spent too many benjamins sending kites to the team 
red beam on the bloodclot 
things ain't quite what they seem 
trying to find the bigger picture i'm liking the memes 
kill the game like i'm ghostface i'm just liking the screams
i don't even take a pee without monetizing the streams
i done red on everything like i'm advertising Supreme
clientele big xl they don't make my size in Celine 
nah ain't into fashion if i ain't feasting i'm fasting
defeat taste like cow feet taste defeat when i'm rapping
frankie puller what's happening
apple pay and i'm tapping in
if they pull out go after them
time to pull up we back again 

Deck

INS logo on the flamethrower 
i light em up back to back like a chainsmoker
get placed in a coma facing the soldier 
hundred shots fired you barely grazed my shoulder 
i keep my heat by the freezer
on a planet full of apes i'm caesar 
charlie horse talk spicey like tandoori
we ain't on the same page they a sad story 
mad corny i don't even know your backstory 
back up off me let me live i'll be back shortly 
liquid on the flow call it H20 
in the kitchen at the stove making plates to go 
grind over time whether rain or snow
so i'm stacked with the good like Trader Joe 

Eso

mad technology pouring out of my bodily
audibly causing chaos i play em all off methodically 
sonically not robotically it's human made, you afraid
when i die don't say "this one stings" throw me a huge parade
super spray hide your face we do it in kabuki way 
represent the dead bent like operation dumile 
the death toll, heads roll, they callin me bazooka shay
every hero needs a villain live from the kumite 
dangerous, nightcrawler bamf! where the students play
you ain't gotta puke protein for you to lose your whey 
jewelry yeah you got a extravagant taste 
what a waste like katy perry in space
i illustrate while you trace
kill a tape while you chase clout
i seal your fate with a fist 
no you laid out, played out 
no hard feelings i don't suffer from ED
you're lyrics a little limp mine hit like a DDT 

Frankie

oh yes we on that life
catch me coming down the mountain with a combat knife
so precise that, you could get your contacts sliced
and the hands are quick, you could get your jaw tapped twice
you shit-for-brain no name lame, that bites like cujo
i'd rather masturbate to kathy bates than hear you flow
and you know, that misery it, loves company 
pin 'em to the mat like 1,2,3 i emerge triumphantly
he should be least of your
concerns when i speak with raw
beatin P is, not an easy chore like defeating thor
your frees, they produce enough cheese to feed the poor
my frees, so cold they locked behind a freezer door
frankie, my myself and i is who i'm speaking for 
sprinkle dope across the verse, shout to shamiek moore 
catch me out in the ybor, city with a sweet whore
try to photograph me and naaah i take a detour

Dolly’s music, storytelling, and fearless spirit have inspired generations of artists and touched millions of lives around the world. From her unforgettable songs to her generosity, authenticity, and unwavering belief in the power of a dream, Dolly Parton’s legacy is one that will continue to inspire generations to come. 

Rest in heavenly peace, Dolly ❤️

Courtesy of Grand Ole Opry Archives

snippet.title: Surviving Minecraft's Best Horror Mod
snippet.description:
Today I'm diving deep into The Broken Script, one of the strangest and most unsettling Minecraft horror mods I've ever played. What starts as a normal Minecraft survival world slowly turns into a corrupted Minecraft ARG filled with creepy entities, random events, impossible structures, hidden dimensions, glitches, world corruption, and things that feel like they absolutely should not be happening in Minecraft.

I played a ridiculous amount of The Broken Script to see just how far this mod goes. Unlike most Minecraft horror mods, The Broken Script is extremely unpredictable. Strange entities can appear in the distance, structures can suddenly generate around you, the world can change without warning, and the game itself can begin behaving like something is wrong with it.

If you like Minecraft horror, scary Minecraft mods, Minecraft ARGs,  cursed Minecraft, survival horror, mysterious entities, analog horror, liminal Minecraft, or heavily modded Minecraft, this is one of the wildest mods I've played.

snippet.title: My Girlfriend asked me if Majora's Mask was any good
snippet.description:
You’ve met a terrible fate haven’t you? Maybe some vitamins can fix that! Head to https://drinkag1.com/boymeetsgirl to save an extra 20% on your first AG1 subscription, for a limited time.

The past couple months my Girlfriend has been obsessed with Zelda, and this week she wanted to know what the deal was with Majora’s Mask. If she had a nickel for all the friends I have that have a tattoo of that mask she’d have two nickels, which isn’t a lot but it is weird that it happened twice. Anyway, Majora’s Mask is the follow up to Ocarina of Time and is the final Zelda entry for the Nintendo 64. It borrows a lot from its older sibling, but it also does some entirely distinct things as well. It’s a really unique game, and honestly one I never expected to have made my girlfriend play, but then again Tarny keeps asking me stuff about Zelda. Hope you enjoy!

snippet.title: SOCIETY 100% // HARDEST LEVEL
snippet.description:
Download Asphalt Legends for free here: https://gmlft.co/PACMANxZOINK
Use code ASPHALTPACMAN for a free in-game bonus.
The PAC-MAN event is live in Asphalt Legends until September 15th.

Society is an interesting level which I have finally completed, through the pain of high cps and tight timings, this actually fits my skillset much better then many other levels in the top 5.
Society being the first top 3 to be verified with cbf, the difficulty of the level was definitely not held back at times. However, this level is still quite unbalanced but it is very approachable.
Not much more needs to be said, was difficult but was able to pull it off! Thanks for all the support and I hope we can continue to push forward towards the human limit.
